mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% compresses equity discount rates, increasing present value of future cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: CPI index level above 260.0 indicates high inflation, triggering Federal Reserve monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and reduces S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 260.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Joint condition of low unemployment (UNRATE < 5.0%) and high housing starts (HOUST > 1400.0) signals strong labor market and housing demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0 AND HOUST > 1400.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) increase equity discount rates and reduce S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as higher interest rates depress equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust consumer demand and economic growth, supporting equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST is above its 30-day moving average, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 signals economic contraction, reducing corporate earnings and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Joint condition of high unemployment (UNRATE > 6.0%) and declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0) signals weak labor market and economic contraction, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 6.0 AND INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust economic activity and stronger corporate earnings, supporting equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO is above its 30-day moving average, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
